args.sql:
SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.parent_id = 1 THEN oi.qty * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END) as digital_sales,
    SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price) as total_sales
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id
WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped');

SELECT 
  SUM(order_items.qty * order_items.unit_price) / COUNT(DISTINCT orders.id) AS avg_order_amount
FROM orders
JOIN order_items ON orders.id = order_items.order_id
WHERE orders.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')

SELECT 
    c.name AS category_name,
    SUM(oi.qty * (oi.unit_price - p.cost)) AS gross_profit
FROM categories c
JOIN products p ON c.id = p.category_id
JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY gross_profit DESC
LIMIT 1;
